title: Accounting Firm Equity Stake For Sale in Luxembourg
tagline: The business is an established independent accounting and advisory network operating across several European countries. - The opportunity involves acquiring a majority economic stake while maintaining voting control with qualified professionals to comply with professional ownership requirements. - The business generates recurring revenue through accounting, audit, tax, payroll, legal, and advisory services. Its diversified service portfolio and client relationships support repeat business. - The network is positioned to benefit from additional acquisitions and cross-selling opportunities. - The investment is sponsored by a Swiss fiduciary with practical experience in accounting, payroll, and corporate services. - The growth strategy includes acquiring smaller accounting firms and deploying technology to automate back-office operations. - The platform also aims to expand across markets connected through existing group operations, shared languages, and planned development. - The target network has 40 employees. - Its operating model includes local offices supported by shared service centres. - The high monthly revenue relative to the 40 employees is attributed to the business's established network of accounting and advisory firms operating across multiple European countries. Revenue is generated through recurring accounting, audit, tax, payroll, legal, and advisory engagements. The network's local offices, professional teams, and shared IT platforms enable efficient service delivery. The reported revenue reflects the wider target network's operations and client base rather than the output of 40 employees alone. - The business has a business registration certificate. - The advisor handling the transaction is based in Switzerland and is available to facilitate the process. They can travel to Luxembourg if required.
